label: ISSUE_ANNOTATION_NOTEMPTY
definition: A Issue Test, applied to a SingleRecord, that evaluates: Are there any annotations associated with the record? It returns: EXTERNAL_PREREQUISITES_NOT_MET if the bdqval:annotationSystem is not available; POTENTIAL_ISSUE if an annotation in the bdqval:annotationSystem exists and has an oa:hasTarget referencing the bdqffdq:SingleRecord under evaluation with matching bdqval:annotationAlertIf criteria; otherwise NOT_ISSUE. It uses the following default authority and/or parameter values: W3C Web Annotation. Its behavior can be altered by the following parameter(s): bdqval:annotationSystem,bdqval:annotationAlertIf.
description: Are there any annotations associated with the record?
notes: While there is a W3C standard on 'web annotation', there is no TDWG recommendation on how this standard could be applied to annotating Darwin Core records. While implementation of this Test is currently problematic, TG2 considers annotations attached to any aspect of a Darwin Core record justifies this Test as a placeholder in the hope of future developments. The Test queries the bdqval:annotationSystem; the execution framework supplies oa:hasTarget, an IRI identifying the bdqffdq:SingleRecord under evaluation (for example dwc:occurrenceID when it is an IRI, or the IRI of the record in its data source), that is, the IRI that annotations on the record would have as their oa:hasTarget. The value of bdqval:annotationSystem identifies an annotation system that can be queried, for example the IRI of a W3C Web Annotation Protocol container or of a published oa:AnnotationCollection {[https://www.w3.org/TR/annotation-protocol/]}. The default, "W3C Web Annotation", names the data model, not a system that can be queried, so with the default the Response.status is EXTERNAL_PREREQUISITES_NOT_MET unless the implementation is configured with an annotation system. The Test validation data use a static oa:AnnotationCollection, https://bdq.tdwg.org/draft/docs/guide/implementers/annotation_test_fixture.jsonld, as the bdqval:annotationSystem.
expectedResponse: EXTERNAL_PREREQUISITES_NOT_MET if the bdqval:annotationSystem is not available; INTERNAL_PREREQUISITES_NOT_MET if oa:hasTarget is bdqval:Empty; POTENTIAL_ISSUE if an annotation in the bdqval:annotationSystem exists and has an oa:hasTarget referencing the bdqffdq:SingleRecord under evaluation with matching bdqval:annotationAlertIf criteria; otherwise NOT_ISSUE.
authoritiesDefaults: bdqval:annotationSystem default = "W3C Web Annotation" {[https://www.w3.org/annotation/]} {"oa:Annotation vocabulary" [https://www.w3.org/TR/annotation-vocab/]},bdqval:annotationAlertIf default = "oa:Annotation with oa:hasTarget having as object any dwciri:term instance that is part of the SingleRecord under Test." {[https://www.w3.org/TR/annotation-vocab/]}
examples: [oa:hasTarget="https://example.org/bdq/test/occurrence/1", bdqval:annotationSystem default: Response.status=EXTERNAL_PREREQUISITES_NOT_MET, Response.comment="The bdqval:annotationSystem is not available"],[oa:hasTarget="https://example.org/bdq/test/occurrence/1", bdqval:annotationSystem="https://bdq.tdwg.org/draft/docs/guide/implementers/annotation_test_fixture.jsonld": Response.status=RUN_HAS_RESULT, Response.result=POTENTIAL_ISSUE, Response.comment="An annotation in the bdqval:annotationSystem has an oa:hasTarget referencing the record"]
